INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.

2. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.

3. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.

4. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

5. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

6. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Writing for information – Paragraphs, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Writing for information – Paragraphs.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Writing for information – Paragraphs.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Writing for information – Paragraphs.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Writing for information – Paragraphs.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.

   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.

   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 6.3.1 Writing to give information – Dialogue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Presentation skills – Debate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
